title: Buddhist Mahâyâna Texts
altTitles: Sacred Books of the East, vol. 49
attributionNote: The volume gathers anonymous Mahayana texts. The Awakening of Faith is traditionally ascribed to Aśvaghoṣa, but its authorship and Chinese origin are disputed; the sutras are anonymous compositions of the Mahayana movement.
description: This volume is the classic English introduction to Mahayana scripture: Aśvaghoṣa's Discourse on the Awakening of Faith in the Mahâyâna in seventeen books, the Larger and Smaller Sukhâvatî-vyûha on the Pure Land of Amitâbha, the Vajrakkhedikâ (Diamond Sutra), the Larger and Smaller Prajñâ-pâramitâ-hridaya (Heart Sutra), and the Amitâyur-dhyâna-sûtra on the meditation of Amitâyus.
historicalContext: The texts were translated by E. B. Cowell, F. Max Müller and J. Takakusu for the Sacred Books of the East, volume 49 (1894). Together they introduced the Pure Land, Perfection of Wisdom and tathāgatagarbha traditions to English readers.
availabilityNote: Complete for this volume. The Awakening of Faith and the five sutras are streamed from the Internet Sacred Text Archive at read time, one book or sutra per chapter. The volume's introduction and notes are not part of the work.
